## AgentCore ReAct / RUN (all streams)
Queries log group `/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/cre_deal_rentroll-Nh63z6GXmK-DEFAULT` across **every** microVM stream. Look for `RUN agentcore_<box>` (runtime, harness, identity, memory, gateway or tools_fastmcp, policy, builtin, skills, eval, observability). skipped|failed means that box did not succeed. Payments is never success. Default range: last 1 hour. Set **Refresh** to 1 minute. Do not use Last event time on the log group — idle `GET /ping` VMs sort first.

properties.title: Latest ReAct RUN lines (all streams)
properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/cre_deal_rentroll-Nh63z6GXmK-DEFAULT'
| fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message
| filter @message like /RUN /
| filter @message not like /GET \/ping/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100

properties.title: Latest /invocations (POST, 422, 500)
properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/cre_deal_rentroll-Nh63z6GXmK-DEFAULT'
| fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message
| filter @message like /\/invocations/
| filter @message like /POST / or @message like / 422/ or @message like / 500/
| filter @message not like /GET \/ping/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50

properties.title: Errors / exceptions
properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/cre_deal_rentroll-Nh63z6GXmK-DEFAULT'
| fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message
| filter @message like /(?i)(error|exception|traceback| 500 )/
| filter @message not like /GET \/ping/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50

properties.title: RUN vs ping vs POST /invocations (5 min bins)
properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/cre_deal_rentroll-Nh63z6GXmK-DEFAULT'
| fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /RUN / or @message like /GET \/ping/ or @message like /POST \/invocations/
| stats sum(strcontains(@message, "RUN ")) as run_lines, sum(strcontains(@message, "GET /ping")) as ping_lines, sum(strcontains(@message, "POST /invocations")) as invocations by bin(5m)

properties.title: Latest RUN agentcore_* box lines
properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/cre_deal_rentroll-Nh63z6GXmK-DEFAULT'
| fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message
| filter @message like /RUN agentcore_/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100

properties.title: agentcore_* boxes (count by token)
properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/cre_deal_rentroll-Nh63z6GXmK-DEFAULT'
| fields @message
| parse @message /RUN (?<box>agentcore_[a-z0-9_]+)/
| filter ispresent(box)
| stats count() as lines by box
| sort box asc
